text: Has the shortness of breath become worse with exertion, and have you noticed any leg swelling or changes in your urine output? Additionally, have you experienced any pain or pressure in your pelvic or shoulder areas?

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your urgency. Given the combination of a large ovarian mass, shortness of breath, and abdominal girth, I need to confirm if there is fluid accumulation around your lungs or abdomen. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray and Abdominal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Right-sided pleural effusion; Abdominal_Ultrasound: Large mass in the right ovary, significant ascites present.

speaker: Doctor
